steps.message:
Here is an actionable audit of `StaticHeavy/`. Every occurrence carries a `file:line` so you can jump straight to it, and one grand total of **28** reconciles across the category table, the top-pattern ranking and the per-file table.

### Category summary (grand total 28)

| Category | Sites |
|----------|-------|
| Time | 7 |
| File System | 11 |
| Console | 4 |
| Environment | 2 |
| Network | 2 |
| Randomness / identity | 1 |
| Culture / serialization | 1 |

### Every call site with location

- Time: OrderProcessor.cs:21, OrderProcessor.cs:22, OrderProcessor.cs:25, OrderProcessor.cs:34, NotificationService.cs:7, NotificationService.cs:16, NotificationService.cs:18
- File System: OrderProcessor.cs:26 (`File.WriteAllText`), OrderProcessor.cs:26 (`Path.GetTempPath`), OrderProcessor.cs:40, OrderProcessor.cs:42, OrderProcessor.cs:46, ConfigLoader.cs:7, ConfigLoader.cs:12, ConfigLoader.cs:32, ConfigLoader.cs:34, ConfigLoader.cs:38, NotificationService.cs:18
- Environment: OrderProcessor.cs:39, NotificationService.cs:15
- Network: NotificationService.cs:24 (`new HttpClient()`), NotificationService.cs:29 (`GetAsync`)
- Console: OrderProcessor.cs:48, ConfigLoader.cs:25, NotificationService.cs:12, Program.cs:7
- Randomness / identity: OrderProcessor.cs:18 — `Guid.NewGuid()` in `CreateOrder`
- Culture / serialization: OrderProcessor.cs:45 — `JsonSerializer.Serialize` in `ArchiveOrder`

### Per-file counts (sum = 28)

| File | Sites |
|------|-------|
| OrderProcessor.cs | 12 |
| ConfigLoader.cs | 6 |
| NotificationService.cs | 9 |
| Program.cs | 1 |

### Deliberately NOT behind a seam

`Path.Combine` (OrderProcessor.cs:26, OrderProcessor.cs:39, OrderProcessor.cs:46, NotificationService.cs:14) and `Path.GetDirectoryName` (ConfigLoader.cs:31) are pure, deterministic helpers — they take no ambient input and are trivially testable, so they are excluded from the 28. Note `Path.GetTempPath` is different: it reads ambient machine state, so it IS counted under File System. Nothing is parked in an "additional observations" section outside the totals.
